title: Shared implementation review
description: Review the completed feature for behavioral correctness, regression risk, file-shape preservation, and adherence to the spec's edge cases before merge.
acceptance_criteria: Review verifies the full flow against the spec, with emphasis on append-mode detection, meals provenance idempotency, and header extraction boundaries.
Review checks that developer changes remain focused, avoid unintended structural regressions, and preserve existing shopping-list text semantics.
Review records any findings or explicitly states that no material findings remain after implementation, testing, and documentation are complete.
